history.summary: A micro 18-unit freehold new launch (TOP 2029) by a small developer in Joo Chiat, 4BR at $2,390 psf / $2.93M with zero URA history. The freehold D15 address is the only draw; boutique scale, small-developer execution risk, an 11-min MRT walk and uncompleted status make it an Avoid for investment.
history.rating_rationale: Verde is an 18-unit boutique by MNG 108 (small developer) completing only in 2029, so there is no transacted track record and no URA series to underwrite value; $2,390 psf is in line with launch pricing but a $2.93M quantum in an 18-unit block means almost no resale liquidity. The 910m/11-min walk to Eunos MRT is mediocre, and buying off a 2029 TOP ties up capital with SSD/holding risk through most of a 5-7yr window. Score_1000 399 reflects a sub-market profile.
